_comment: Curated list of companies with verified public ATS APIs, relevant to your target roles. Every slug should be tested live before being added -- see job-scan/SKILL.md for how to verify a new one. Copy this file to companies.json and replace the examples below with your own list.

title_filter._comment: A posting must match at least one 'domain' term (keeps the scan on-topic instead of matching any junior/intern role regardless of department) AND must not match any 'negative' term. Matched against job title only (see title_matches() in job_scan.py). Edit both lists to match your actual target roles.

location_filter._comment: A posting must match at least one of these in its location string to be kept -- keeps the scan to roles you can actually take given your own work-authorization situation. Case-insensitive substring match. Replace with your own country/city list.
